notes: «حدثني محمد بن الحسن قال حدثني محمد بن الحسن الصفار»: two men, each with its own «حدثني» (rule 7 counter-example), so two links
«يرفعه إلى» is the gap marker (rule 8), kept unnamed; «رجل» is unnamed and not identified
Abu Abd Allah stays a narrator (named inside the chain); Amir al-Mu'minin is named only in the words after the chain and is the last link
